name: Charlotte
source:
A female warrior who inherited the will of her father, a renowned martial artist, who protects the ruins of fire. Although she cannot use magic, she excels in physical strength, surpassing even Anduke in terms of raw strength. Because of her penchant for the strong, she falls in love with Anduke, after he defeated her.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071230090604fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/dangel/chara.html]Mink[/url]]
